death.note: saint.gr gives the reign and not a year: «μαρτύρησαν μαζί με άλλους εβδομήντα πέντε Χριστιανούς στην Αφρική, επί αυτοκράτορα Διοκλητιανού (284-305 μ.Χ)». The interval is that reign as the page prints it.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Ηλιόδωρος και Βενούστος και οι συν αυτοίς μαρτυρήσαντες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives him his own head line beside Heliodorus. **He is not the corpus's `venustus-of-cibalae`**, and the two are easy to separate: that man is one of the company of the deacon Donatus at Cibalae in Pannonia, whom the Romanian calendar keeps on 21 august; this one suffered in Africa with Heliodorus and seventy-five others under Diocletian, on 6 May. Different day, different province, different company. **The seventy-five are not named and are therefore no folders.** No place in Africa beyond the continent, no manner of death, no relics, no hymn.
